title: Nourishing Juicy Norwegian Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with tender Norwegian lamb, featuring celery salt and a rich deglaze fond, served in a slate tile vessel, this dish is both ayurvedic sattvic friendly and perfect for a monsoon day.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced carrots and cubed potatoes, cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle the celery salt over the stew and stir to combine.
Add the lamb broth to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot in a slate tile vessel.
